description: One download sets Squire up on the Mac from start to finish without Terminal: the Mac check, one yes for what will be installed, Apple's developer tools, Claude Code, the Claude sign-in, naming the Squire, the folders, the always-on session, the phone, the Keychain, the browser, the nightly backup, wake-ups, voice notes, the health check and the guided first conversation. The installer also sets Claude Code's auto-compact window.
title: The installer, with no Terminal
